name: Little Monica Monogatari
source: The town of Little Monica is famous for its vast culture of arts and music. Will is an orphan who used to learn music in Little Monica, however he has long since moved out of the town. Many years later, Will decides to go back, where he meets the daughters of his previous mentor: Celia, May, and Tina. However, strange and unexplainable phenomena keep happening around town...
